prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One colossal brown Neobear, three metres at shoulder and five metres snout to short tail, much bulkier than a normal brown bear. FOUR enormous weight-bearing plantigrade paws, immense shoulder hump, heavy thick neck, broad head, short natural tail. All fours, head low, mouth slightly open. Thick skin under coarse dark brown fur; broad smooth chest/shoulder masses, few large directional locks at silhouette rather than microscopic hairs. Full-body near-side three-quarter front view showing all four paws. No horns, dorsal spikes, tack, extra limbs, armour, exposed wounds, rider or comparison person. Reference painting only.
